createringtoncurrency.ponder.depositor_t: Taking payments with a Depositor Terminal
A Depositor Terminal collects payments for its owner
Whoever places it is the owner. Right-clicking your own terminal opens its menu
Set a price there: a number of bills of one denomination. The light turns green once it is set
Looking at a terminal shows customers its price and its owner
They pay in cash by right-clicking it with those bills in hand
Right-clicking with a Bank Card pays the same price out of their bank account instead
Paid bills stay inside the terminal, which holds up to nine stacks
When the next payment would not fit, the light turns red and the terminal stops taking payments
As the owner, empty it with Take all in its menu
Hoppers and funnels can pull the bills out as well, so the terminal never fills up
Redstone signals from a Depositor Terminal
Every completed payment sends a redstone pulse into the block behind the terminal
Card payments pulse it too: enough to open a door or fire a dispenser
A comparator reads how full the terminal's storage is

createringtoncurrency.ponder.atm.text_6: ATMs come in eight colours that all work the same
